g.title: DKA_QSP
g.text: Diabetic Ketoacidosis and the Hyperglycaemic Hyperosmolar State — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
Two deficits, two disposal architectures, one cause. Glucose has two exits (insulin-mediated disposal and a renal escape valve whose conductance is the ECF volume);
ketoacid has one (saturable oxidation). Bicarbonate is not a compartment but the residual of the strong-ion difference.
